summary.text: Amy Laufer is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 55, representing parts of Albemarle, Fluvanna, Louisa and Nelson counties, serving since January 10, 2024. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources, Education, and Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: Amy J. Laufer was born in Fond du Lac, Wisconsin, according to the House's member profile.

The profile says she earned a B.S. in geology from the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee in 1996 and an M.A. in secondary science education from Columbia University Teachers College in 2001, and lists her occupation as former teacher.
